summary: The first real candidate exposes unsupported rebated frame/leaf and projecting hinge hardware in the current preparation assumptions. Source admissibility is not disproved.

findings.detail: Official model page/API and embedded USDZ metadata agree on witnessk, source UID and CC BY 4.0. Both texture files are embedded; no missing dependencies or additional terms found.

normalize attempt 000002 reports Measured panel dimensions differ from recipe by >1 mm. Recipe dimensions describe the leaf (component 3); Panel also includes correctly attached upper hinge barrels (6/7) and fittings (8/9). The current implementation measures the entire rigid group. This failure is not an out-of-range leaf.
Default PhysX decompositions exceed original visual bounds by up to 26.21 mm for the panel and 24.34 mm for the frame at scale 0.72. They introduce closed intersections; no dynamic gate was run.

A diagnostic trial with welded collider-only vertices, shrinkWrap=true, voxelResolution=2000000, errorPercentage=1 and convex small fittings reduced intersections but did not clear them. Convexifying the entire panel fills its rebate; the frame still needs component-wise collision partitioning. The cooker also warned of non-GPU-compatible oblong hulls; no CUDA physics claim is made.

Original mid-height mesh sections show complementary rebates with visible clearance. This sample is not proof of clearance over the entire door. The current rectangular-opening check uses the full leaf envelope inset by only 1 mm, which includes the frame stop and is not the clear aperture of a rebated frame.

Latch component 2 remains within the leaf edge in the closed source. No latch operation is apparent from this inventory, but unobstructed opening and a geometric stop still require validated collision geometry and runtime evidence.

next_steps: Extend the common recipe to identify leaf measurement geometry separately from attached hinge hardware.
Represent the measured clear aperture and geometry-preserving convex partitions for rebated frame/panel components; verify collider surface accuracy and GPU compatibility.
Rerun normalization, static checks, normalized visual review and isolated GPU physics before promotion to 5.1. No new download is needed.
